name: directus-extension-d1-inbox
description: /d1-inbox: the Inbox of found files on the server. Lists the files the inbox crawler found in a person's or team's folder, links them to samples, operations and tests as the caller (edit rights checked), adds a surface scan file to an insert or edge as the caller (Directus create permission), undoes a batch, queues a rescan, keeps the auto-link opt-in, and answers the crawler's auto-link calls (machine secret).
